config.asset_session_definition: primary-universe asset in a full session with finalized 5m bars >= 80% of the benchmark's bar count and identity_check == MATCH

collection_policy.eod_archive: after 18:30 Europe/Istanbul on each weekday: universe + benchmark + descriptive-only symbols, intervals 5m (period 5d) and 1m (period 5d); append only missing finalized bars
collection_policy.failure_policy: failed/empty fetch -> logged in fetch_failures, no bars written; no forward fill, no fabricated zero-volume bars; missing data stays MISSING
collection_policy.storage: local SQLite archive (append-only tables enforced by triggers) + content-addressed raw responses; never Firestore

config.coverage_policy: DATASET READY requires ALL of: full prospective sessions >= minimum_full_sessions; valid primary asset-sessions >= minimum_asset_sessions; EVERY primary-universe asset has >= minimum_sessions_per_primary_asset valid sessions. Missing data is never filled; an asset below the minimum keeps the study incomplete; assets are never removed from the universe
config.end_policy: DATASET READY FOR PROSPECTIVE AUDIT once coverage_policy is met; collection continues to target_sessions; no early stopping on results; the collector computes no outcomes, models or PASS/FAIL
config.full_session_definition: weekday on/after prospective_start_session whose benchmark finalized 5m bars start <= 10:05 and end with a bar starting >= 17:50 (observed bars, no assumed close); shorter observed sessions are SHORT_SESSION and do not count
config.identity_policy: provider symbol/exchange/currency from the same response metadata vs expected <SYMBOL>.IS/IST/TRY; MATCH only when all reported and equal; missing -> UNVERIFIED; conflict -> MISMATCH (stored, never in primary analysis); no defaults are written
config.no_lookahead_policy: every bar carries first_seen_at (UTC); an evaluator at time T may only read bars with first_seen_at <= T and bar_end <= T, and revisions with observed_at <= T
config.partial_bar_policy: a bar is partial if bar_end > retrieved_at, or if it is the last bar of the response for the current local session date and retrieved before 18:30 local; partial observations go only to partial_bars (append-only); the finalized bar is stored once in bars and linked in bar_finalization; partial data never feeds labels/features
config.revision_policy: first-seen finalized bar is immutable (unique symbol, interval, bar_start); later differing provider values go to bar_revision with original_hash, previous_hash, new_hash, observed_at, changed_fields; evaluators use first-seen values unless they explicitly request revisions observed <= evaluation time
config.source_note: existing Yahoo intraday access via research collector adapter; not a production recommendation
config.start_policy: prospective_start_session = first weekday whose opening auction (09:40 local) starts strictly after frozen_at; if no bars are observed on that date (holiday) the first later date with observed bars is the effective start (recorded, not chosen). Data stored before it is WARMUP_ONLY / PRE_START; preflight data lives in a separate store and is never validation data

visibility_probe_policy.latency_definition: first_seen_at - bar_end for each finalized bar first seen by a probe run
visibility_probe_policy.request: period 1d per symbol and interval; provider retry helper only; exponential backoff on consecutive failures (max 1800 s)
visibility_probe_policy.subset_rule: first k symbols by sha256(study_version|symbol), then sorted; benchmark always included
